invariants.title: Invariants gate
invariants.empty: the invariants list is empty — an empty list is not a pass (zero-value guard): a list exists only with reasons
invariants.not_object: check item is not an object: %(entry)r
invariants.missing_why: `%(path)s` is missing why (required: a check without a reason nobody dares to delete, and it becomes a zombie)
invariants.no_criteria: `%(path)s` has no criteria (give at least one of must_contain / must_not_contain)
invariants.not_string_list: `%(path)s` must_contain / must_not_contain must be arrays of strings
invariants.unreadable: `%(path)s` cannot be read (does the file exist? paths are relative to the repo root) — say so when unreadable, never pass silently
invariants.off: Invariants gate: REFLECT_INVARIANTS not configured ⇒ this gate is off (pluggable module; to enable: REFLECT_INVARIANTS=invariants.json, spec = {"checks": [{path, must_contain?, must_not_contain?, why}]})
invariants.spec_missing: REFLECT_INVARIANTS=%(name)s is configured but the spec file is missing — write the spec (or drop the knob)
invariants.bad_shape: spec file %(path)s has a bad shape: expected {"checks": [...]}
